The agent read untrusted content; confirm this download.

sources.content:
# The organization policy from Contracts v1, unchanged in substance.
schema: privometry.policy/v1
name: acme-default
extends:
  - privometry/core-catastrophic@^1
  - privometry/secrets@^1
defaults:
  mode: enforce
  unmatched: auto
  fail_modes:
    catastrophic: closed
    secrets: ask
rules:
  - id: no-terraform-destroy
    category: catastrophic
    when:
      action: shell_exec
      program: terraform
      subcommand: destroy
    verdict: deny
    message: Run terraform destroy from CI, not from an agent.
    locked: true
  - id: allow-tests
    when:
      action: shell_exec
      program: [npm, pnpm, go, mvn, gradle]
      subcommand: [test, "run test"]
    verdict: allow
  - id: ask-untrusted-network
    when:
      action: network_fetch
      untrusted_input_seen: true
    unless:
      host: ["*.github.com", "registry.npmjs.org"]
    verdict: ask
    message: The agent read untrusted content; confirm this download.
overrides:
  privometry/core-catastrophic:git-force-push: deny
exceptions:
  - rule: privometry/secrets:read-env-file
    target_path: "*/.env.example"
    reason: Example file with no real secrets
    expires_at: 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z
    approved_by: appsec@acme.com
sources.name: acme-default
